Remark
[nonnegative curvature of biinvariant metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0159 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-biinvariant-curvature-formula Lie groups with biinvariant Riemannian metrics always have nonnegative sectional curvature; with more work the curvature operator itself can be shown to be nonnegative.
